description: create_segments_with_pids (layout_index.ex:154-174) sorts but doesn't dedup boundaries: contiguous shards produce a zero-width artifact segment with merged pid lists and DUPLICATE keys in the orddict passed to :gb_trees.from_orddict/1 (documented precondition: unique keys — tree undefined). Fires on the default layout from initialization_phase.ex:38 / materializer_bootstrap_phase.ex:65. Contained today only because storage_racing lookup_key! can't match zero-width segments; lookup_range/get_next_segment return wrong pid lists now. Fix: Enum.dedup() after boundary sort (verified against the 28 tests in PR for bedrock-5ap); optionally filter zero-width segments. See audit in PR.
title: LayoutIndex builds corrupt gb_tree for contiguous shard layouts (production default affected)
